receiptAsset.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit the reference receipt for a California-focused expense splitting app. Preserve the photoreal ivory thermal paper, straight-on view, gentle crease, torn bottom and black monospace printing. Replace the printed receipt with this exact text, using aligned columns: RIVERSIDE DINER / SAN FRANCISCO, CA / 10/31/2026 / TABLE 07 / Grilled fish 30.00 / Vegetarian plate 24.00 / Pasta 21.00 / Shared dessert 9.00 / SUBTOTAL $84.00 / TAX $7.35 / TIP $16.80 / TOTAL $108.15 / THANK YOU. No EUR anywhere. No extra decorative objects. This is a fictional demonstration receipt. Do not print the words fictional or demonstration. Remove the dark surrounding background entirely; the receipt should be an isolated cutout on genuine transparency with no glow or shadow backdrop. The complete paper fits within the frame with clear transparent margins.

captureNotes: Actual native app UI with fictional local data. Local receipt provider is demonstration-only; these assets do not establish real-provider test coverage. Do not upload rejected v1 assets.
